description: Initialized research project workspace for 'AI-Assisted Academic Research Harnesses: Traceability, Trust, Audit and Reproducibility'

parameters.title: AI-Assisted Academic Research Harnesses: Traceability, Trust, Audit and Reproducibility
rqs: What is the state of the art in academic research and literature review harnesses that integrate AI assistance, and what design mechanisms do they provide for traceability, trust, auditability and reproducibility?
How are AI-assisted research harnesses evaluated for reproducibility, auditability and trustworthiness, and what gaps remain for the construction of a novel artifact?

description: Phase-0 Inception: 'AI-Assisted Academic Research Harnesses: Traceability, Trust, Audit and Reproducibility' [Design Science, SCOPING_REVIEW] compiled protocol fingerprint sha256:b787926bd0e6a898c06c16b0fc1915fa90e81fe1b0b66a0fe74ac1817a384001
Compiled peer-review grade protocol.json (sha256:c7c4e3...) with 3 RQs, 4 INC / 5 EXC criteria, and 7 synthesis dimensions

Socratic refinement v2: relaxed INC-03/INC-04 to enrichment flags, added PubMed+DBLP, 3 new extraction dimensions (provenance_maturity L0-L3, evidence_availability, provenance_standard_compliance), ai_agent_architecture multi-label, 3-agent majority-vote screening. Citation authenticity verification against Crossref/OpenAlex + abstract hydration and JATS stripping
Federated discovery v2 across 5 balanced providers (50 OpenAlex, 50 arXiv, 50 Semantic Scholar, 50 Crossref, 50 PubMed; 2023-2026 window) focused on core population/intervention facets
Two-tier deduplication by persistent ID (DOI, arXiv ID, PubMed ID) and fuzzy title matching
Bibliographic authenticity verification against Crossref/OpenAlex with abstract hydration and metadata normalization
PRISMA 2020 Title & Abstract screening completed across 12 batches: 84 eligible studies included (35.1%), 155 excluded (64.9%). PRISMA screening flow report generated.
Harvested 48 legal Open Access full-text PDFs (29 via OpenAlex cascade + 19 direct from arXiv preprint repository) into pdfs/ directory.
Extracted 48 section-aware structured Markdown documents with YAML frontmatter via PyMuPDF into extracted/ directory.
Checked 48 candidate studies across OpenAlex works API and Crossref API for retractions, expressions of concern, and update events. 0 retracted, 0 flagged, 0 unresolved.

Executed deterministic DAS/CAS regex baseline over 47 extracted Markdown documents. Detected 16 studies with repository links, 7 with both public data and code links, 32 with explicit availability statements.

Aggregated 8 analyst COI chunks against study manifest for 47 unique studies. Surfaced 5 industry affiliations/donations (Meta, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI), 4 declared-no-conflict statements, 1 academic funding statement, 37 no-statement.
Constructed citation graph from 62 DOIs across included studies using OpenAlex works API. Computed normalized PageRank scores and rendered interactive PyVis network visualization.
Curated, formatted, and linted 84 included studies into canonical BibTeX database with protected capitalization and standardized citation keys.

Parsed 47 extracted Markdown documents into 2,875 structured AST chunks with section hierarchy and methodology metadata. Indexed idempotently into ChromaDB vector store using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings.
Extracted 10 protocol matrix dimensions across 47 indexed studies using section-aware semantic retrieval and dynamic Pydantic models. Produced canonical CSV, JSON, and Markdown synthesis tables.
Executed grounded synthesis for RQ1, RQ2, and RQ3 with atomic citation tokens [STUDY#SECTION#CHUNK] and NLI claim entailment verification. Generated 42 verified factual claims across the corpus.

Clustered 42 grounded claims into 10 thematic consensus groups using sentence-transformers embedding cosine similarity (threshold 0.40). Surfaced active debates, unresolved methodological claims, and high-consensus findings.
Joined Consensus Cartographer clusters with Phase 4 verification outputs (retraction, DAS/CAS, COI, RoB). Annotated every cluster with per-study verification context and deterministic trust ratings.

Composed comprehensive, publication-grade systematic scoping review manuscript in synthesis/literature_review.md conforming to PRISMA-ScR guidelines, complete with PRISMA flow diagram, corpus taxonomy, RQ synthesis, trust audit findings, and architectural implications.
Completed 4-pass multi-agent screening with majority voting and senior adjudication tie-breaking.
Downloaded 20 OA PDFs and manually ingested 13 missing PDFs for the final 58 included papers.

Hybrid retrieval over rebuilt chroma_db (3814 chunks, collection scholar_docs): 30 chunks + 30 claims per RQ across RQ1/RQ2/RQ3, merged into 90-claim ledger with entailment verification (39 VERIFIED / 51 AMBIGUOUS).
Semantic clustering (sentence-transformers, cosine, threshold 0.40) of 90 grounded claims into 18 consensus groups: 1 high-consensus finding, 1 active debate, 4 unresolved, 12 provisional.
Regenerated 7-dimension cross-study methodology comparison matrix from rebuilt chroma_db index over 64 extracted fulltexts.

Merged 510 multi-agent full-text claims into canonical ledger (RQ1=166, RQ2=132, RQ3=212; 493 fulltext + 17 abstract-only across 57 studies); all 510 evidence quotes verified verbatim against extracted source text (char-window + token 6-gram coverage >= 0.90); replaced deterministic RAG claim ledger per user directive.

Regenerated Consensus Cartographer over 510 verbatim-backed full-text claims (semantic cosine, all-MiniLM-L6-v2, threshold 0.40): 95 clusters total = 16 high-consensus, 7 active debates, 37 unresolved, 35 provisional.

Regenerated deterministic RAG synthesis baseline into synthesis/rag_baseline/ for head-to-head comparison: 90 claims (30/RQ, entailment-verified 39/90=43.3%), consensus 20 clusters (2 HC / 0 debates / 3 unresolved / 15 provisional). Baseline corpus = all 64 indexed chroma docs (18 of which were screened-out), so 11 RAG-cited studies are non-included. Multi-agent outputs untouched.

description: Documented head-to-head comparison of deterministic RAG synthesis vs multi-agent full-text claim extraction (coverage, verification rate 43.3% vs 100%, corpus-scope compliance, consensus structure 20 vs 95 clusters).

Generated formal methodology report covering the full pipeline: protocol, search/verify/screen (4 screeners, Fleiss kappa 0.408, 58/181), PDF extraction, Phase-4 verification, RAG synthesis (A) vs multi-agent full-text claims (B), verification pipeline v1-v4, consensus cartography, provenance and limitations.

Finalized literature_review.md grounded in the 510-claim verbatim ledger + 95 consensus clusters: 3 RQ chapters drafted from ledger-only evidence and machine-verified (0 ungrounded study citations), updated PRISMA flow (58 included / 64 extracted / 3814 chunks / 510 claims), recomputed 58-study taxonomy, Phase-4 audit, consensus map and RAG-vs-multi-agent method decision. Prior draft preserved as literature_review_draft_v1.md.

Drafted publishable manuscript reports/manuscript_draft.md (abstract, intro, methods incl. two-pipeline synthesis, RQ1-3 results, consensus cartography, approach comparison, Phase-4 audit, discussion/limitations/conclusion, 36 numbered references auto-built from literal corpus metadata via Crossref/arXiv/OpenAlex lookups). Every in-text number grounded in the 510-claim verbatim ledger; author names placeholder pending human curation for 23 preprint records.

Wrote reports/pipeline_engineering_report.md (end-to-end screening->extraction->RAG->synthesis retrospective with parameters, artifact map, 8 upgrade targets) and reports/literature_lessons_and_reading_list.md (12 corpus-grounded lessons L1-L12 + 20 priority method papers with DOIs + 4 canonical external methods refs) to guide harness kit/skill upgrades.
